picks.desc: A fast, ad-free home screen for Google TV, LG webOS and Samsung Tizen. One button to undo.
picks.readme:
# Free My TV **A fast, ad-free home screen for Google TV, LG and Samsung TVs.** Trending picks from your own apps, the weather at a glance, and a look that follows the sunset.
Open source. Built with Claude Code. One button to undo. [**freemytv.io**](https://freemytv.io) · [Install](#install) · [LG TVs](#lg-tvs-webos) · [Samsung TVs](#samsung-tvs-tizen) · [Any TV](#any-tv) · [Make it yours](#make-it-yours)
## What you get - **No ads.** No sponsored rows, banners or autoplaying promos. Not one. - **Your apps, front and center.** The streaming apps you actually use, on a glass shelf. Pick them and their order right on the TV, or (on Google TV and Android TV) let the one you opened last come first. - **Trending, not sponsored.** Three fresh picks every hour (up to six, in Home Settings) from what's trending this week and the latest releases, only from apps you already have, and from the services you choose. The focused one opens wide and the others show their posters. Movies and Shows get their own tabs, and on Google TV your own [Plex library](#your-plex-library-optional) can join in. - **Continue Watching** (Google TV and Android TV). *Home Settings* → *Top of the screen* puts what you left halfway in your apps on top, with its progress, and OK picks it up in its app. Or a big clock, or the picks. - **Your TMDB key from your phone.** *Home Settings* → *TMDB key* shows a QR code: scan it and paste the key. On LG and Samsung, type it with the remote. - **Weather and markets, one press away.** The hour-by-hour forecast (or the next 5 days), sunrise and sunset, and live crypto prices; on LG and Samsung, also rain in the next two hours, the UV index and the air quality. - **Live TV or your box on HDMI, one press away.** *Home Settings* → *Live TV button* picks what the first top button opens: Live TV, as before, or one of the TV's HDMI inputs, shown under the name you gave the input on the TV when it has one (or, on Google TV, Android TV and Fire TV, the name of the device on it). *Home Settings* → *Inputs* picks which inputs the drawer shows, and in what order: OK shows or hides one, ← → moves it, Live TV included — so a TV with no antenna can take its tile out. On Google TV and Android TV, *Settings* → *Inputs* does the same. - **What's playing.** Music, a podcast or the radio going on in the background shows on the home screen and the screensaver: the title, the artist and the app, from any app that tells Android what it plays (*Home Settings*, off until you turn it on). - **The status at a glance, and a mouse** (Google TV and Android TV). *Home Settings* → *Status icons* puts Wi-Fi or Ethernet, Bluetooth audio and a USB drive at the top of the home screen; off, nothing listens for them. A mouse or an air-mouse remote works too: hover moves the focus, the wheel scrolls, a click picks. - **Light by day, dark by night.** It follows your city's real sunset, the way your phone does. - **A screensaver to match.** Full-screen photos of the picks with a big glass clock. On LG and Samsung, *Home Settings* → *Screensaver* can make it a large clock with the weather instead, drifting slowly so it doesn't burn into OLED screens. Optionally (*Watch from the screensaver*, in Home Settings), OK opens the title on screen in its app, and any other button just closes it. - **Dimming for a dark room** (LG and Samsung). *Home Settings* → *Dim* darkens Free My TV's own screens, not the apps you open: low, medium, high, or automatic (medium from 22:00 to 07:00). Off until you pick it. - **Your own photos** (Google TV and Android TV). picks.readme:
A tiny, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux.
Runs your Docker images and works with the docker CLI, Compose and buildx you already use.

Download · Features · Build from source · Releases

🇬🇧 🇮🇩 🇩🇪 🇪🇸 🇫🇷 🇮🇹 🇵🇱 🇧🇷 🇻🇳 🇹🇷 🇷🇺 🇸🇦 🇯🇵 🇰🇷 🇨🇳 🇹🇼
Kiri speaks 38 languages. Is yours one?

--- Kiri is a lightweight replacement for Docker Desktop and OrbStack, written in Rust. It runs containers in one small Linux VM (or straight on the kernel on Linux) and speaks the Docker Engine API, so your tools just work. The name comes from the Igbo word *ntakịrị*, "small". ## Why Kiri - **Fast**: a container starts and exits in about 2.5 ms through the Docker API. That's around 80 times faster than Docker Desktop. - **Light**: the VM sleeps after 60 s idle, the daemon stays at about 15 MB, and it wakes in about 0.15 s. - **Compatible**: `docker`, Compose, buildx, `docker login` and amd64 images through Rosetta. - **Local domains**: `http://.kiri.local`, with HTTPS from Kiri's own certificate authority. - **More than containers**: a one-command Kubernetes cluster and Linux machines. - **A native window** for containers, images, volumes and networks, plus a menu bar item. - **In your language**: 38 languages, on macOS, Windows and Linux alike. ### In your language Kiri's window and setup come in these languages. It follows your system's language, and you can change it in Settings → Appearance. picks.name: totk-pc-recomp
picks.desc: Static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom to native Windows and Linux x86-64, with a Vulkan renderer. Game files not included.
picks.readme:
# TotK Recomp

**TotK Recomp** is a static recompilation of *The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom* (Nintendo Switch, 2023) into a native x86-64 application for Windows and Linux ([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No game files are included.** You need your own legally obtained copy of *Tears of the Kingdom*, dumped from your own console: the base game and the 1.1.0, 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update. Instructions for obtaining those files will not be provided.
>
> The game is built from your files on your machine, so the result contains the game. It is for your own use. Do not share it.

## Status

Early development. The game is playable on Windows and Linux; visual bugs and crashes are still expected.

Report problems as issues, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Features

- Native code, not emulation
- Game updates 1.1.0, 1.2.1 and 1.4.3; 1.2.1 and 1.4.3 saves carry over between them
- Takes NSP and XCI game files, and compressed NSZ and XCZ as they are: the setup unpacks them itself
- 60 fps by default; up to 144 fps or the monitor's refresh rate (experimental)
- Custom resolutions (1080p, 2k...), supersampling and AMD FSR 1 upscaling
- NVIDIA DLSS / DLAA on RTX GPUs: the setup downloads `nvngx_dlss.dll` from NVIDIA's DLSS SDK repository
  (github.com/NVIDIA/DLSS, NVIDIA RTX SDK license) when it finds an RTX GPU; untick it in the setup to skip it
- HDR10 output with peak, game and HUD brightness settings
- 16:10 (Steam Deck, handhelds), 3:2 (Surface, Framework), 21:9 and 32:9 (ultrawide) game resolutions, with the camera and the interface in that shape
- Anisotropic texture filtering up to 16x, for sharp ground into the distance
- In-game settings menu (F1) and performance overlay (F10)
- Play time across runs on the Game tab of the settings menu, kept in `playtime.txt` next to the saves
- Discord Rich Presence ("Playing TotK Recomp" with the play time), off by default, own application id supported
- Setup and in-game menu in English, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese
- Keyboard, mouse and gamepad with remapping, rumble and gyro
- Stereo or 5.1 surround sound output
- Xbox button prompts: LB, RB, LT, RT, Menu and View, and A, B, X and Y as labelled on the button to press, with either button layout
- Shaders prepared at install instead of during play
- Mods made for emulators: unpack a mod into the `mods` folder next to `totk.exe`; switch and order them in the menu. RomFS
  mods, TKMM's merged output and ExeFS code patches (`.ips`, `.pchtxt`) work; the game rebuilds itself for code patches
  ([docs/mods.md](docs/mods.md)). HD texture packs work: the port grows the texture heap a pack asks for by itself. Tested
  with the HDPacks.com 4K Texture Pack v1.0 on 1.4.3 and 1.2.1; other packs come with no guarantee
- Atmosphère cheats: put a cheat file into a mod and switch its cheats in the menu ([docs/cheats.md](docs/cheats.md))

## Planned

- VRR

## Installing

### Windows

Requirements: Windows 10 or later, an x86-64 CPU with SSE4.2 (AVX2/FMA machines get a faster build), a GPU with Vulkan 1.3 and `VK_EXT_external_memory_host`, about 36 GiB free during setup (20 GiB after).

1. Download `TotK-Setup-<version>-windows.zip` from [Releases](../../releases/latest) and unpack it.
2. Start `TotK-Setup.exe`. If SmartScreen warns about an unsigned app, choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
3. Pick your game files, the language and an install folder, and press *Start*. The setup builds the game once. With
   an NVIDIA RTX GPU it also downloads NVIDIA DLSS, unless you untick *Download NVIDIA DLSS*; turn DLSS on in the
   menu (F1).
4. Play `totk.exe` from the install folder.

### Linux

Requirements: as on Windows, plus Linux 6.7 or later and glibc 2.34 or later (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Fedora 35, SteamOS 3).

1. Download `TotK-Setup-x86_64.AppImage` from [Releases](../../releases/latest), or build it ([docs/installer.md](docs/installer.md), "Linux release").
2. Make it executa

picks.desc: Play your own Switch games on iPhone/iPad — one-click macOS app, no terminal. | 把 Switch 游戏装进 iPhone：图形界面一键构建，不用命令行。Bring your own game.
picks.readme:
**Your Switch games, running on your iPhone.** **Not an emulator. No terminal. A macOS or Windows app does the whole build in a few clicks.** [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/stargazers) [![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/LNPANDY/NX2Apple?style=social)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/network/members) [![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple/issues) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)](LICENSE) [![Games](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FLNPANDY%2FNX2Apple%2Fmain%2F.github%2Fbadges%2Fgames.json)](.github/badges/games.json) [![中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇨🇳_中文-available-green)](README.zh-CN.md) [![English](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇺🇸_English-current-blue)](README.md) [![Svenska](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇸🇪_Svenska-available-green)](README.sv.md) [![Deutsch](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇩🇪_Deutsch-available-green)](README.de.md) [![Français](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇫🇷_Français-available-green)](README.fr.md) [![Italiano](https://img.shields.io/badge/🇮🇹_Italiano-available-green)](README.it.md) #### 🆕 Latest highlights - **Windows launcher (`NX2Apple-windows-x64.zip`)**: Build iPhone and iPad IPAs on Windows with the same 1.2 interface, a bundled engine tree (no git needed), guided first-run setup, multi-core NSO rewriting, and in-app self-update (`NX2Apple.exe`). - **Switch 2 games**: Pick a Switch 2 game folder or `.nup` file in the Mac or Windows launcher, with no `prod.keys` needed, and play on Mac, iPhone, or iPad. - **Custom touch controls, split Joy-Con, and Steam Controller (2026)**: Resize buttons, move the left stick, or arrange every control in the visual layout editor on iPhone and iPad. Physical controllers support per-game or global button remapping, split a Bluetooth Joy-Con pair into two sideways controllers on Mac, and support the Steam Controller (2026). - **One app for iPhone and iPad**: All your games live inside one shell app (or export an unsigned IPA for AltStore and SideStore), each carrying its own host framework so engine updates never force a rebuild, with Cover Flow in landscape, per-game settings and mods, safe game deletion that keeps your saves, and 7 languages. - **Console mode**: Plug in a controller and press Select, or start directly in console mode. The library goes full-screen like a Switch home menu, and holding Home for 2 seconds quits a game. Every release is in the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md).
--- ## What NX2Apple is NX2Apple runs Nintendo Switch games on your Mac and iPhone from your own game dumps. It is not an emulator: the game's own code runs natively on Apple silicon, and Metal draws it. A Mac app, the launcher, does the build in a few clicks (unpack, rewrite, translate the shaders, pack) and then keeps your games in a library you start with **Play**, the way a Switch does. It is a community fork of **[nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)**, which does the actual work (the code rewriter, the Horizon host, NVN on Metal and every game's profile); this fork adds the launcher and a short list of patches, and follows nxnative every day. ## Requirements - **An Apple silicon Mac.** The launcher opens on **macOS 13 or later**. Building needs Xcode with the iOS SDK, and NVN games need [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/download/all/?q=Xcode%2027.2

picks.readme:
# Stitch Design Skills A collection of agent skills and plugins for [Google Stitch](https://stitch.withgoogle.com), following the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) open standard. Compatible with coding agents such as Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode (manual install). ## Quick Start ### 1. Install Plugins (Recommended) The fastest way to set up the full Stitch plugin suite globally. #### Codex Add the Stitch Skills marketplace, then install the plugins you need.
Via CLI (recommended) ```bash codex plugin marketplace add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --ref main \ --sparse .agents/plugins \ --sparse plugins/stitch-design \ --sparse plugins/stitch-build \ --sparse plugins/stitch-utilities ``` > [!TIP] > The `--sparse` flags are optional — they limit the checkout to only the > listed paths for a faster clone. Omit them to pull the entire repository.
Via the Codex UI Navigate to **Settings → Plugin Marketplaces → Add** and fill in: | Field | Value | |---|---| | **Source** | `https://github.com/google-labs-code/stitch-skills` | | **Git ref** | `main` | | **Sparse paths** | *(optional)* `.agents/plugins`, `plugins/stitch-design`, `plugins/stitch-build`, `plugins/stitch-utilities` |
Once the marketplace is registered, install any combination of: - **`stitch-design`** — design-focused skills - **`stitch-build`** — build and component skills - **`stitch-utilities`** — utility and helper skills #### Claude Code & Cursor ```bash # Claude Code — installs into the current project npx plugins add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --scope project --target claude-code ``` ```bash # Cursor — installs into the current workspace npx plugins add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --scope workspace --target cursor ``` #### OpenCode OpenCode does **not** use `npx plugins` / `npx skills` or the Codex/Claude marketplace layout. Install skills and the Stitch MCP server manually: **1. Skills** — copy the skill folders you need into a discoverable path: ```bash # Project-local (recommended) mkdir -p .opencode/skills cp -R plugins/stitch-design/skills/generate-design .opencode/skills/generate-design # repeat for other skills under plugins/*/skills/ ``` OpenCode also discovers `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/` (see [OpenCode skills docs](https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/)). > **Naming:** OpenCode requires skill `name` frontmatter to be lowercase kebab-case and match the directory name. Skills that use `stitch::…` names (or other non-kebab forms) need the `name` field and folder renamed before OpenCode will load them. Extra frontmatter such as `allowed-tools` is ignored. **2. Stitch MCP** — add a remote MCP entry in project `opencode.json` or `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` after completing the [Stitch MCP setup](https://stitch.withgoogle.com/docs/mcp/setup/): ```json { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "mcp": { "stitch": { "type": "remote", "url": "YOUR_STITCH_MCP_URL", "enabled": true } } } ``` Replace `YOUR_STITCH_MCP_URL` with the endpoint from the Stitch MCP setup flow (credentials/env vars from that guide still apply). Tool names inside skill instructions may differ from OpenCode builtins (`webfetch` / `bash` instead of `web_fetch` / `run_command`). Prefer the OpenCode tool names when adapting a skill for OpenCode. ### 2. Install Skills Selectively Choose only the specific skills you need. > [!IMPORTANT] > Stitch Design Skills often have inter-dependencies. If you choose to install skills selectively, ensure you include all required dependencies. ```bash npx skills add google-labs-code/stitch-skills ``` You can run the following commands to see the help documentation for plugins and skills: ```bash npx plugins --help npx skills --help ``` ## Prerequisites These skills require the **Stitch MCP** server to be co

picks.readme: # pixelfx. **244 pixel art effects and animations, every one a small piece of code.** Fire, explosions, magic, weather, UI, pickups, critters and more. Play them live, recolor and mirror them, drop them into a browser game, or export sprite sheets for any engine. Plus a Claude Code skill that makes new ones the way a picky pixel artist would: draft, render, look, refine. Every effect that involves a character is **acted out**: he winds up, lets go, freezes on contact and recovers, and a target takes the hit. Twelve whole moves chain the effects into attacks from wind-up to recovery. # AI 角色参考与合成工作台 · 中文版（3合1）

> **姿势库（1,439 张素体白模 + 1,439 张深度图 Depth） + 服装库（3,224 套：ギア写实 1,407 + Shisei 中国历代 57 套/227 视角 + ギア动漫 1,320 + CharaDB 二次元 440） + 人像库（1,499 位） = 6,162 条全中文参考数据 / 12,022 张本地高清图，另有 1,760 张来源站点参考图**，集成 **5 大 AI 图像协议直连工作台** 与 **原生 ComfyUI 自定义节点插件（`custom_nodes`）**。

![画廊总览预览](docs/preview.jpg)

![AI 角色合成台预览](docs/studio.jpg)

<details><summary>手机端预览</summary>

**在线演示：** <https://ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app/>
**原始站点：**

- 人像库：<https://ai-portrait-gallery.pages.dev/>

**原有图库作者：** ギア（@giaaibusi）；二次元服装作者：たき AI（[@taki_auto](https://x.com/taki_auto) · [CharaDB](https://charadb-2fi.pages.dev/)）。
**中文版维护：** Anhao · [X @anhao_ai](https://x.com/anhao_ai)
**GitHub：** <https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh>

> ⚠️ **免责声明（必读）**：
> 1. **学习与创作限定**：本项目及配套插件/工作流**仅供个人学习、人体动态研究、合法艺术创作与技术交流使用**，严禁用于任何违反法律法规、生成违法违规/淫秽色情内容或侵害他人合法权益（如未经授权的真人肖像换脸）的用途。
> 2. **NSFW 敏感内容提示**：图库包含部分 18+ 成人向人体素体姿势与内衣/性感穿搭参考，系统默认开启「安全模式 (SFW)」隐藏，**未成年人严禁解锁或访问**。
> 3. **来源与版权声明**：原有姿势、现实服装、人像参考图源自原作者 **ギア（@giaaibusi）** 公开站点；440 套二次元服装源自 **たき AI（@taki_auto）** 的 [CharaDB](https://charadb-2fi.pages.dev/)（详见其 [LICENSE](https://github.com/taki-ttt/charadb/blob/main/LICENSE)），版权归各自原作者所有；本仓库仅为中文翻译整理与工程学习存档，禁止将图库图片打包倒卖。使用者因违规使用产生的一切法律责任由使用者本人独立承担。

---

## 这是什么

原站是ギア（@giaaibusi）发布的三大 AI 绘画参考图库（姿势、服装、人像），元数据全部为日文，且分散在三个独立站点。本仓库（v2.0）完成了**三站合一、全量中文化、AI 角色合成工作台与 ComfyUI 原生插件升级**：

1. **三库四站全量本地镜像（11,568 张图）** —— 完整收录姿势库（素体白模 2,878 张 + 深度图 Depth 2,878 张 WebP）、服装库（2,814 张 WebP）、人像库（2,998 张，全尺寸 `1600×2000` 高清 WebP）的全部缩略图与高清原图，支持纯离线浏览与静态托管。
2. **原有图库全中文元数据** —— 动作体系、姿势分类、服装款式、穿搭标签、人像分区、发长与 51 种细分发型全部译为地道中文，自动组装的生图提示词纯净无日文干扰。
3. **三合一 AI 角色合成工作台（Web Studio）** —— 基于 **React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + TypeScript 7 + shadcn/ui + TanStack Router** 构建的响应式多页面应用（兼容 PC / 平板 / 手机）：
   - 从三大图库任意挑选 **人像 + 服装 + 姿势（支持素体白模 / 深度图一键切换）** 组合配方，或一键随机捏人；
   - 支持拖拽、剪贴板粘贴（`Cmd+V` / `Ctrl+V`）或 URL 添加多张自定义附加参考图；
   - 内置 **5 大 AI 图像协议直连**（Google Gemini、OpenAI GPT Image、阿里云百炼 Qwen、字节火山方舟 Doubao、**本地 ComfyUI**），生成记录通过 **IndexedDB** 本地持久化保存。
4. **原生 ComfyUI 自定义节点插件（`custom_nodes`）** —— 本仓库同时是一个即插即用的 ComfyUI 插件！直接 `git clone` 到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/` 即可在 ComfyUI 画布内使用 **姿势 / 服装 / 人像 / 三合一角色配方** 4 个自定义节点（姿势与配方节点内置 `use_depth` 深度图切换，可直接接入 ControlNet Depth）与内置的 **6,162 条中文可视化弹窗选图器**。

---

## 核心功能

### 1. 三大参考图库（姿势 / 服装 / 人像）
- **姿势参考库（`/poses`）**：4 大体系（全身单人・标准系 / 全身单人・性感系 / 上半身单人 / 双人缠绵）、26 个动作分类、288 组姿势、5 种视角（正面 / 斜前 / 侧面 / 背面 / 俯视），支持**按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式、卡片内多角度切换，以及 **`[ 素体白模 | 深度图 (Depth) ]` 一键切换预览与下载**。
- **服装参考库（`/costumes`）**：8 大穿搭分类（春季 / 夏季 / 秋季 / 冬季 / 内衣・睡衣 / 性感穿搭 / 泳装・度假 / 派对・礼服）、86 个中文细节标签与英文 Prompt 关键词。
- **人像参考库（`/portraits`）**：2 大分区（正脸参考 893 / 造型氛围 606）、4 种发长（短发 / 中发 / 中长发 / 长发）、51 种细分发型，支持**精选题集**与**热门榜单**一键筛选。
- **统一交互体验**：中文关键词实时检索、灯箱高清原图预览与下载、一键「加入合成配方」。

### 2. AI 角色合成台（`/studio`）
- **3+N 参考图组合**：3 个核心槽位（人像 / 服装 / 姿势，姿势槽位内置 `[ 白模 | 深度 ]` 实时切换）+ 任意张自定义附加参考图（点击上传、拖拽文件、剪贴板粘贴、填写图片 URL）。
- **参考拼图预览与导出**：弹窗查看三合一高清参考拼图（`1800×1200` Canvas 实时合成），支持一键下载拼图 PNG。
- **12 种画风预设 & 纯中文结构化提示词**：内置「无预设（跟随参考图）」、写实人像写真、日韩杂志画报、复古胶片写真、2.5D 游戏原画立绘、日系二次元插画、新海诚感动画电影、日式黑白漫画网点、3D 次世代角色渲染、3D 潮玩手办质感、赛博朋克霓虹、角色设定集立绘（纯白底）共 12 种画风，根据已选素材自动组装提示词。
- **5 大 AI 图像协议与高级参数**：

picks.name: Claude-BugHunter
picks.desc: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
picks.readme:
![claude-bughunter banner](assets/banner-v2.svg) # claude-bughunter > A self-contained Claude skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work · **83 skills** · 15 slash commands · **681 disclosed-report patterns** (433 now individually cited & auditable) across 24 core vulnerability classes · enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices · engagement-folder scaffolding · Burp MCP integration · battle-tested across authorized red-team and bug-hunting engagements, plus public training platforms (DVWA, OWASP Juice Shop, Hacker101, testphp.vulnweb.com). Built by **[Sachin Sharma](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sachinsharma8080/)** — Bug Hunting & GenAI Security Research.

SPONSORED BY
    

--- ## What is this? `claude-bughunter` is a drop-in skill bundle for the [Claude Code skills system](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/skills). Install once and Claude Code stops being a chatbot and starts behaving like a senior bug-hunting researcher or red-team operator: it knows the techniques, the chain templates, the VRT mappings, the platform CVE chains, and the hygiene — and it stays in scope. Four layers stack: - **Think** — `bb-methodology` + `redteam-mindset`: the 5-phase non-linear workflow, critical-thinking framework, and red-team operator discipline. - **Hunt webapps** — 58 `hunt-*` skills curated from 681 disclosed HackerOne reports: per-class detection patterns, payloads, bypass tables, and chain templates. - **Hit the perimeter** — enterprise platform chains (M365/Entra, Okta, vCenter, SSL-VPN appliances, SharePoint, cloud IAM): current 2024–2026 CVE chains + post-credential escalation. - **Ship it** — `triage-validation` + reporting + `evidence-hygiene`: the 7-Question Gate, VRT-aware severity, OOS rebuttals, PII redaction, and red-team deliverables. All triggered automatically by topic — describe what you're testing in plain English and the relevant skill loads. No invocation by name. --- ## Quickstart **Option A — install as a Claude Code plugin (recommended).** From inside Claude Code: ```text /plugin marketplace add elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter /plugin install claude-bughunter@elementalsouls ``` All 83 skills + 15 commands load namespaced under `claude-bughunter:` and update when you bump the plugin version — no files copied into `~/.claude/`. **Option B — copy install (no plugin system / pin to a clone):** ```bash git clone https://github.com/elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter.git cd Claude-BugHunter ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux bash scripts/install.sh # Windows (PowerShell) pwsh ./scripts/install.ps1 ``` Both copy the skills + commands into `~/.claude/` (macOS/Linux) or `%USERPROFILE%\.claude\` (Windows) and wire the `hunt` engagement scaffolder. **What each install path gives you:** | Path | 83 skills + 15 slash commands | `cbh` CLI | `hunt` scaffolder | |---|---|---|---| | **A — plugin** | ✅ namespaced under `claude-bughunter:` | ➕ separate `pipx install` | ❌ clone-only | | **B — copy install** | ✅ copied into `~/.claude/` | ✅ from the clone | ✅ from the clone | The plugin is the fastest path to the skills + slash commands. The terminal-native `cbh` runner installs standalone — `pipx install git+https://github.com/elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter` — so plugin users can add it without a full clone (see [`cbh` CLI](docs/cbh-cli.md)). The `hunt` engagement scaffolder ships with the clone (Option B). That's it. Open Claude C
